question: What complementary resources are still separated by a material missing edge after searching the exchange structures that already exist?

reassessments.prior_thesis: digital-transformation acceptance blockers may create bounded specialist-routing tasks
existing_exchange_found: Xuzhou already has first-batch full-chain digital-transformation service providers
government already procured digital-level assessment and third-party acceptance organizations
public/private research and service institutions already provide enterprise digital-transformation support
reassessments.reason: The ecosystem is real and crowded. Public evidence does not prove a recurring blocker class that incumbent providers cannot handle economically. Existing-provider completeness is counterevidence, not opportunity proof.
reassessments.kill_or_reopen_rule: Reopen only if a controller supplies a live redacted blocker plus evidence that the incumbent route cannot solve it at acceptable cost/time/risk.

reassessments.prior_thesis: retired domain judgment plus younger AI execution may form a temporary acceptance-bounded micro-cell
existing_exchange_found: multiple provinces already operate flexible/project-based Silver Engineer or retired high-skill talent programs
commercial expert-data vendors already organize domain experts for AI data production and evaluation
technology-manager and expert-enterprise matching mechanisms already organize flexible expertise
reassessments.reason: Retired-expert utilization and expert-plus-AI work are not unorganized categories. The exact micro-cell may still differ, but no observed failure yet proves that existing flexible expert routes leave a valuable uncovered interface.
reassessments.kill_or_reopen_rule: Reopen only around a specific observed task where expert judgment and AI execution must be separated and current expert/consulting routes fail on economics, speed or acceptance.

reassessments.prior_thesis: idle or externally shareable scientific instruments may be composed around SME testing outcomes
existing_exchange_found: Jiangsu's science-resource platform lists 35,000+ shared instruments, 22,000+ service items and thousands of completed service transactions
Xuzhou Medical University exposes an external large-instrument sharing portal
Nanjing already has a market-operated vertical platform that lets SMEs reserve expensive biomedical instruments and technical services online
reassessments.reason: The generic exchange 'idle instrument -> external SME access' is already organized and transacting. A narrower 'problem semantics -> multi-instrument method chain -> interpretation' thesis would require fresh direct failure evidence and must not inherit the generic sharing thesis.
reassessments.kill_or_reopen_rule: Only reopen a narrower outcome-level route after observing a firm that can access instruments but still cannot economically translate its problem into a validated test-method chain.

reassessments.prior_thesis: fragmented non-OEM maintenance/failure traces plus domain adjudication may become reusable industrial-AI training/evaluation assets
existing_exchange_found: XCMG/Hanyun is already building an OEM-led engineering-machinery vehicle-network high-quality dataset for predictive maintenance and later aftermarket extension
commercial expert-data companies already provide expert annotation, quality control and evaluation workflows
high-quality industrial-dataset construction and evaluation platforms already exist
observed_structural_failure: current manufacturing-AI policy analysis still reports data barriers, weak interoperability and low data utilization as common problems
national high-quality-dataset policy explicitly pushes expert-deep-participation because data annotation is moving from labor-intensive to knowledge-intensive work
public OEM examples prove first-party data can be organized, but do not prove independent service/rental repair traces are already governed and reusable across actors
reassessments.missing_edge_hypothesis: a rights-cleared cross-actor interface that turns narrow non-OEM fault/repair records plus domain-expert adjudication into model-ready evidence without requiring each small service actor to become a data company
reassessments.why_not_already_solved_hypothesis: record ownership and customer confidentiality are fragmented; schemas differ; labels are sparse; expert adjudication is expensive; and OEM-led data platforms have stronger control over first-party telemetry than over independent aftermarket traces
known_blockers: No direct evidence yet that 5 independent Xuzhou service/rental actors retain comparable repair/failure records
No direct evidence yet that those actors can lawfully authorize reuse beyond operational service
No direct buyer evidence yet that the exact available fields add value beyond existing OEM/public datasets
Existing OEM aftermarket expansion may eventually close the edge
reassessments.cheapest_decisive_validation: Without copying any customer or equipment data, inspect the blank schema/field names and rights boundary of maintenance records at 5 independent service/rental actors; only if at least 3 have comparable lawful record classes, present the abstracted schema to one industrial-AI/dataset buyer and ask whether it changes training/evaluation value enough to justify a paid pilot.
kill_conditions: usable records do not exist or are mostly oral
schemas are too heterogeneous for a minimum common record
OEM/platform contracts already absorb the same traces
a buyer says the fields add no incremental model/evaluation value
economics require the founder to perform ongoing annotation or consulting labor

current_decision.reason: It is the only current candidate that survives an existing-exchange search without pretending the edge is already proven. The next blocker is origin-side field truth, not more architecture or solution design.
